coverage_policy: Keep the complete seven-token greedy chain and one complete conditional alternative. Select the alternative using the existing frozen maximum draft path-mass rule over the first six positions, then follow conditional greedy transitions. Select before target verification; no target-informed choice.
coverage: Every native round over full fixed-output continuations, including rounds after token 512 in 1024-output cases. Retain lattice scores/candidates. Credit maximum matching-prefix coverage plus one target correction/bonus against the next eight observed native output tokens. Exclude only terminal rounds lacking eight-token lookahead. Assert native path coverage equals native emitted count on every included round. This is a native-trajectory counterfactual, not an alternative rollout.
controls: Pair each captured continuation with an uninstrumented native run from a fresh cache using identical chunked prefill; require identical output IDs. Window 1 control then capture; window 2 capture then control, with reversed cell order. No captured-run timing enters speed estimates.
cost: Measure existing eight-row target graphs at physical batch one and two. Both paths read the same committed SSM slot and immutable prefix KV. The second path has eight separate writable KV entries and separate verify/replay scratch rows. Two warmups, seven paired samples per context, alternating B1/B2 order (reverse in window 2); three run() calls per timing sample. Record wall and CUDA event spans including plan/upload/replay. Check prefix KV and committed SSM/conv hashes before/after. Record cross-shape target argmax differences; do not assert numerical equivalence across physical batch shapes.
screen: For each cell/window, estimate alternative decode time as (uninstrumented decode time + native round count * (B2 target wall cost - B1 target wall cost)) / observed coverage ratio, then add actual prefill time. Advancement requires at least 10% lower summed completion time in each window and no cell >5% worse. This optimistic cost/coverage screen cannot pass runtime quality/state/latency gates. A failed screen adds no runtime policy.
promotion: Even a passed cost/coverage screen requires an isolated real two-path verifier with winner-only KV/recurrent commit, correct draft feedback, quality checks, measured full-rollout >=10% useful-turn completion improvement, preserved B4 behavior and memory floor before any serving mechanism. No production promotion in this study.
limits: Two deterministic held-out repository/log tasks per context/output, two reload windows. Greedy, EOS ignored, single agent. No SGLang rerun, no quality score for long reviews, no physical DRAM counters, no claim of counterfactual rollout speed. New API validation changes only chat admission; target/executor/proposer/kernel files must match the previous validated image.
